description: List the 20 private tours and day packages MAPL Tours runs in Jamaica (Dunn's River, Blue Hole, bamboo rafting, Rick's Cafe, zipline, ATV, horseback and more). fromPriceUsd is the price for the smallest party; priceUnit says whether it covers a party of up to N people or one person. Use get_tour with guests for the exact total. Hotel pickup included. Optional keyword or area filter; returns up to 12 rows. Read-only. duration is time at the activity; get_tour adds hotel-and-back times.

area.description: Town or area, e.g. "Ocho Rios", "Negril", "Montego Bay"
